newsitem.title: UK: BA cargo promotion to last until March 16.
newsitem.headline: BA cargo promotion to last until March 16.

text.p: British Airway's has extended until March 16th and in some cases cut air cargo rates further as part of its special spring promotion on its international cargo routes, a BA spokesman said.

The extension of the discounts for pallets and bin rates covers 25 North Atlantic, 14 southern region covering the Middle East, east Africa and the Indian sub-continent, eight Pacific and 13 European routes adding seven Pacific routes to its February "sale".
As with last month the special low rates must be booked within 72 hours of departure and cannot replace existing or permanent bookings and are subject to availability, the spokesman added.
As a wholesaling carrier the special deals are aimed at freight forwarders and are for pallet type 5 and 8 and bins.
The continuation of the sale for a further two weeks indicates it has been successful in attracting business, he added.

Other carriers have not admitted making similar offers in competition to BA but some industry sources said BA is not alone in making discounts. But other carriers have tended to respond on a one-to-one bases rather than proactively issue cutprice lists, they added.
